emails.subject: MT418 Chicago–Denver — schedule change, free move available
emails.body:
Hi Caleb,

This is an automated notice from your MeridianTrip Traveler Portal.

Your flight MT418 (Chicago–Denver) on 2026-05-23 has been retimed by a schedule change. You can move at no cost to MT420, departing later the same day.

If you'd like MeridianTrip Assist to rebook you onto MT420 on your behalf, just reply to this thread or send a Traveler Message and ask. The change will be reviewed by a desk agent before ticketing — typical turnaround within the hour.

If you have questions about this change, please contact Hannah Park (MeridianTrip Schedule-Change Desk) or call our traveler line at +1 (855) TRIP-NOW1.

— MeridianTrip Travel

emails.body:
